## Type Definitions

| Type | Keterangan |
|------|-----------|
| `feat` | Fitur baru |
| `fix` | Perbaikan bug |
| `docs` | Dokumentasi |
| `style` | Formatting, tidak mempengaruhi logic |
| `refactor` | Refactoring kode tanpa ubah behavior |
| `perf` | Optimasi performa |
| `test` | Menambah/memperbaiki test |
| `build` | Build system atau dependency |
| `chore` | Maintenance tasks |
